question: Who is the first Indian President to be born in Independent India?
solution:
The correct answer is **Droupadi Murmu** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****President** Droupadi Murmu

__
 
• ​**President** Droupadi Murmu was elected the 15th President of India.
 
• Since July 25, 2022, **President** Droupadi Murmu, also known as Puti Biranchi Tudu, has held the office of India's 15th president.
 
• She was born on June 20, 1958. After Pratibha Patil, she is the second woman to hold the position and the first member of a tribal community to do so.
 
• Along with being the first President born in Independent India, she is also the youngest person to hold the position. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** జరిగాయి.

 
• On June 20, 1958, Droupadi Murmu was born to a Santali family in the village of Uparbeda in the Rairangpur, Odisha, neighborhood of Baidaposi. Biranchi Narayan Tudu, her father, was a farmer.
 
• Her father and grandfather served as the local council's traditional leaders, or Sarpanch (Gram Panchayat).
 
• They gave her the name Puti Tudu.
 
• Her teacher changed her name from Durpadi to Droupadi, and she had previously gone by the names Dorpdi and Durpadi.
 
• Ram Nath Kovind is the 14th President of India.
 
• That presidential election was held on 17th July 2017.
 
• He was earlier the Governor of Jharkhand.
 
• Pratibha Devi Singh Patil was the first woman president of India.
 
• She was born on 19 December 1934.
 
• She is an Indian politician who served as the 12th President of India from 2007 to 2012.
